You start every Adventure with one extra Inspiration Point.
<Ascendance>.Notes: Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1..
<Ascendance>.Name: <Ascendance>

~Wingspan (Cleric)~.Effect: Quickly fly up to 3 meters. If you're in Worthy Combat, also cast Awe.
~Wingspan (Cleric)~.Name: ~Wingspan (Cleric)~

~Penitence~.Effect:
Make a Check with any Stat against a Unit's Presence Check.
If you pass, it can't cast Healing Spells, do Control Effects or apply On-Roll Effects for 1 minute.
~Penitence~.Notes: Against Epic Monsters, it only last for 2 turns.
~Penitence~.Name: ~Penitence~

~Everlasting Sustenance~.Effect:
You stop the effects of aging on yourself and your companion.
Your companion Levels Up.
~Everlasting Sustenance~.Name: ~Everlasting Sustenance~

~The Clerical Trinity~.Effect:
You have a third Unit beside you that you control, which is another Hero.
Your companion is built like a normal Level 1 Hero, but all its stats are decreased by 1, starts with no separate {Gold}Gold and can not gain Feats.
It always has the same initiative as you and Levels Up only when you Level Up.

Apply the same "soul bond death" rules as your chosen Soulwright Ability at Level 2, and apply the same bonuses to the Stats (or resistances).
~The Clerical Trinity~.Upgrade: For the Quest Masters, note that this companion also counts as a normal Hero for encounter Experience!
~The Clerical Trinity~.Notes:
Come up with a story about why you have your companion and why your god allowed this or gave them to you.
You should now have 3 characters of Levels 1, 3 and 5.
~The Clerical Trinity~.Name: ~The Clerical Trinity~

~Encode Thoughts~.Effect:
You pull a String of Memory or Thoughts (can be visual, auditive, sensory and olphactive) from your own memory.
This String can be up to 1 minute in length.
To view the String, a person can willingly absorb it through the mouth, eyes, nose, etc (corresponding to the type of memories) and visualize the String.
~Encode Thoughts~.Notes:
It is visible to the eye as a magical ribbon-like energy. You can transport this String like you would carry a normal 10x10x10 centimeter object.
The String disappears after being absorbed or if you make another String.
~Encode Thoughts~.Name: ~Encode Thoughts~

~Wraithwalk~.Effect:
You become spectral for 10 seconds (until the start of your next turn).
While spectral, you can move through walls, objects and Units, but not through floors and ceilings.
If the effect doesn't end in an empty space, you are instantly thrown to the nearest empty space and you take 3d4 Pulse Damage.
~Wraithwalk~.Name: ~Wraithwalk~

~Evoke~.Effect:
You start each Worthy Combat with 0 Evoke Points.
When you roll at least 1 maximum die on any Act, gain 1 Evoke Point.
Some Spells can consume all Evoke Points to gain an improved effect ^for each Evoke Point spent^.

You may pick 2 Evocations.
~Evoke~.Notes: You must spend ^all^ EP when you decide to. You can change your Evocations inbetween Adventures.
~Evoke~.Name: ~Evoke~

~Flux~.Effect: Choose a Damage Type from the ones listed below. That becomes your {Color('orange' 'Flux')} Type. Some of your Spells's Damage deal that Damage Type (written explicitly on those Spells).
~Flux~.Upgrade:
1. Fire, 2. Cold, 3. Shock, 4. Pulse, 5. Poison, 6. Acid, 7. Divine, 8. Scourge.
You can change your Flux inbetween Adventures.
~Flux~.Name: ~Flux~

~Diverge~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Act that targets Unit(s) targets an extra Unit in range per Evoke Point spent, but deals -50% Damage (or Healing if it heals) to the secondary targets.
~Diverge~.Name: ~Diverge~

~Overwhelm~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next offensive Act also Single-Stuns one of the Units hit, for each extra Evoke Point spent
~Overwhelm~.Notes:
You can Single-Stun the same Unit, or a different Unit hit. When increasing the Stun Degree inflicted with an Evoke Point, only increase it for one of the hit Units.
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
~Overwhelm~.Name: ~Overwhelm~

~Amplify~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Ability or Attack has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type per Evoke Point spent.
~Amplify~.Notes: Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.
~Amplify~.Name: ~Amplify~

~Obliterate~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Act that targets Unit(s) deals +1d6 Damage on cast, or +1d4 Healing to the target on cast, per Evoke Point spent.
~Obliterate~.Upgrade: These extra dice can not produce more Evoke Points.
~Obliterate~.Notes: If it heals, it does extra Healing. If it deals Damage, it deals extra Damage. If used with Damage over time effects, the extra Damage only happens when you cast the Spell.
~Obliterate~.Name: ~Obliterate~

~Transpose~.Effect: {Evoke}: Teleport up to 4 meters away per Evoke Point spent.
~Transpose~.Name: ~Transpose~

~Summon Familiar~.Effect:
You have a familiar, shaped directly by your {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} (a small demon, a spirit, etc).
The familiar follows you, has its own personality, and casts ^Eerie Bolt^ automatically if you have Evoke Points.
While with you in Combat, it can't take Damage unless purposefully targeted.
~Summon Familiar~.Upgrade:
It has a number of Skills equal to your Level.
It may or may not follow your commands, depending on your relationship.
If it dies or runs away, you can spend 10 minutes to resummon it.
~Summon Familiar~.Notes:
Work with your Quest Master to determine your familiar's look and personality. You may need to work to convince it to do things for you.
The familiar doesn't obey normal Combat rules, and doesn't use Movement or {A}Action Points.

Eerie Bolt.Effect:
Cast automatically and for free, on the same target, after the Warlock targets a Unit within 3 meters.
Can generate an Evoke Point!

~Summon Familiar~.Name: ~Summon Familiar~

~Curse of the Mind~.Duration: Minor curse lasts until end of Adventure
~Curse of the Mind~.Effect:
Choose a Unit. Deal 6d4 Psychic Damage to it and it becomes Single-Stunned.
Apply a ~Combo~ to it.
~Curse of the Mind~.Upgrade: Alternatively, affect it bywith minor curse effects (e.g. is clumsy, stumbles, get pimples, etc), getting -2 on all Checks.
~Curse of the Mind~.Notes:
Be creative with the effects of the minor curse effects!

A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
~Curse of the Mind~.Name: ~Curse of the Mind~

~Wyrd Suture~.Effect:
Roll 1d12 - 4. Then choose a Unit.
If it's negative, deal Scourge Damage to it. Otherwise, Heal it.

{Evoke}: +100% Damage or Healing per Evoke Point spent.
~Wyrd Suture~.Name: ~Wyrd Suture~

~Deathfire Wave~.Effect:
Shoot a bolt of deathly fire in a 1x10 meter line. All Units it touches take 1d4 + 1d6 + 1d8 Scourge or Fire Damage (your choice).

{Evoke}: When it hits a wall or the range ends, the bolt continues at an angle you choose for another 1x10 meters. This happens per Evoke Point spent.
~Deathfire Wave~.Notes: The bolt can't hit the same Unit twice. The bolt travels as if you're drawing multiple lines with the same stroke. For example, if you spend 2 Evoke Points, there will be 3 lines.
~Deathfire Wave~.Name: ~Deathfire Wave~

~Witherwave~.Effect:
Your next {Type} weapon attack deals +50% Damage and applies a ~Combo~.

{Variants}
~Witherwave~.Name: ~Witherwave~

~Soul Drain~.Effect:
Deal 2d6 True Damage to 2 Units.
For each killed, Heal for 4 Health or gain +1 Max Health permanently (your choice).

{Evoke}: Executes non-Epic Units at or below 10% of its Max Health per Evoke Point spent.
~Soul Drain~.Notes:
For example, if you spend 2 Evoke Points, this executes Units at or below 20% Health. If you spend 3 Evoke Points, this executes Units at or below 30% Health. And so on.
Both Units take Damage from the same roll.
~Soul Drain~.Name: ~Soul Drain~

~Veinlight~.Effect:
Choose a 3x3 meter area.
All Enemies in the area take 2d6 + 2d8 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage.

{Evoke}: Increase the area by 3 meters in both directions per Evoke Point spent.
~Veinlight~.Notes: For example, for 1 Evoke Point spent the area becomes 6x6 meters. For 2, it becomes 9x9 meters. And so on.
~Veinlight~.Name: ~Veinlight~

~Curse of Lethargy~.Effect: Choose a Unit. At the start of each of its Turns, it is Slowed.
~Curse of Lethargy~.Name: ~Curse of Lethargy~
~Curse of Lethargy~.Notes: A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.

~Life Sap~.Effect: You can cast Abilties that cost {Mana}Mana by spending 2d6 {Health}Health per 1 {Mana}Mana instead.
~Life Sap~.Upgrade: If you would go Down this way, you still cast the Spell, and go Down immediately after.
~Life Sap~.Name: ~Life Sap~

~Mind Over Matter~.Effect:
You can choose how many Evoke Points you want to spend when spending them.
At any time, you can spend 1 {Mana}Mana to gain 2 Evoke Points.
~Mind Over Matter~.Name: ~Mind Over Matter~

Combat Extras: You have extra Magic Font Spells
~Font Magic~.Effect:
You may select a `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` to pick Spells from.
You get a number of them equal to your Focus.
~Font Magic~.Notes: All Magic Font Spells act like Class Talents. Notes: You can change your Font and Spells inbetween Adventures.
~Font Magic~.Name: ~Font Magic~

~Invoke Kindred~.Effect:
Invoke 3 _Kindred Beings_, each within 10 meters of you. These are creatures themed and shaped to your {Color('magenta' 'Flux')}, which will do your bidding before returning to their original world.

{Evoke}: +1 summon per Evoke Point spent.

Monster.Name: Kindred Being
Monster.Description: Has a 1 Action Point. Takes its Turn at the end of your Turn.

~Attack~.Effect: Deal 1d6 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage, or use an Item or Default Ability.

~Invoke Kindred~.Name: ~Invoke Kindred~

~Curse of Frailty~.Effect:
A Unit you can see becomes special-Frail: it takes +50% Damage the next time it takes Damage from an ally.

{Evoke}: +50% extra Damage per Evoke Point spent.
~Curse of Frailty~.Name: ~Curse of Frailty~
~Curse of Frailty~.Notes: A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.

~Gateway~.Duration: Lasts until end of Combat, or 10 real minutes
~Gateway~.Effect:
Open a _gateway_, and another paired one in a location you can see.
Units and projectiles can go through a gateway and appear through the other.

You can cast this with 0 {A}Action Points and no Cooldown by spending 1 {Mana}Mana.
~Gateway~.Upgrade: The gateway does not have a direction - projectiles going one way come out the same way. Units have Line of Sight through the gates, and their Range counts as if the two gates are connected (obviously).
~Gateway~.Name: ~Gateway~

~Curse of the Plague~.Effect:
Choose a Unit and roll 5d6 to see its _death threshold_.
When it gets to that amount or less Health, you can use a free Reaction to kill it.
Then the curse spreads with the same _death threshold_ to all Units within 2 meters of it.
~Curse of the Plague~.Upgrade: Wherever the plague goes, it kills small plants, insects, and rots wood and rusts metal. It also makes fertile soil infertile, turns textile and paper materials into dust, and decays food and poisons water.
~Curse of the Plague~.Notes: The death threshold can stack from multiple Curses of the Plague! Ask the Quest Master whether a Unit should die from the curse.
~Curse of the Plague~.Name: ~Curse of the Plague~

~Torrent~.Effect:
Choose a Unit. Deal 1d4 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage or apply a ~Combo~ to it.

Then do it again for each Evoke Point you have.
~Torrent~.Name: ~Torrent~

~Overloading Evocation~.Effect: Cast 2 Evocation Talents you Know, combined, with the same Evoke Points applied to both.
~Overloading Evocation~.Name: ~Overloading Evocation~

<Blood Pact>.Effect: This turn, you deal +50% Damage to other Units. Every time you deal 10 or more Damage in one instance, take 5 Psychic Damage.
<Blood Pact>.Name: <Blood Pact>

<Higher Evoke>.Effect: You start each Combat with +1 Evoke Point.
<Higher Evoke>.Name: <Higher Evoke>

~As Fate Willt~.Effect: Gain 2 Evoke Points, then cast a random Evocation spending all your Evoke Points.
~As Fate Willt~.Notes: You can roll 1d6 and reroll on 6.
~As Fate Willt~.Name: ~As Fate Willt~

~Master of Curses~.Effect: Your Curses that are empowered by at least 1 Evoke Point cast as if empowered by +1 Evoke Point.
~Master of Curses~.Name: ~Master of Curses~

~Aura of Ruin~.Requirement: Only usable the moment Combat starts
~Aura of Ruin~.Effect: Reduce the Max Health of all enemies by 10%.
~Aura of Ruin~.Name: ~Aura of Ruin~

~Evoke Entropy~.Effect:
You start each Worthy Combat with 0 Evoke Points.
When you roll at least 1 ~minimum or~ maximum die on any Act, gain 1 Evoke Point.
Some Spells can consume all Evoke Points to gain an improved effect ^for each Evoke Point spent^.

Additionally, you have an extra Talent tier for special Evocations.
~Evoke Entropy~.Notes: You must spend ^all^ EP when you decide to. You can pick one for free Evocation at Level 1, and get more like you would normally get extra Class Talents (e.g. with the extra Known Talents from Intelligence, if above 0).
~Evoke Entropy~.Name: ~Evoke Entropy~

~Consumption~.Effect:
_Consume_ one of your known Abilities until the end of the Adventure to gain 1 Evoke Point.
You can't cast it until the end of the Adventure.
~Consumption~.Name: ~Consumption~

~Inward Invocation~.Effect: Use when ^you^ take minimum or maximum Damage from a dice attack. Gain 1 Evoke Point.
~Inward Invocation~.Name: ~Inward Invocation~

~Borrowed Power~.Effect:
You each Adventure with 2 Evoke Points.
You age 12 times as rapidly.
~Borrowed Power~.Name: ~Borrowed Power~

~Blood Dividend~.Range: 5 meters from you to healed Unit
~Blood Dividend~.Effect:
Your next weapon attack or Spell deals -50% Damage, but heals another Unit for the Damage dealt.
Then it applies a ~Combo~ to one of them.
~Blood Dividend~.Name: ~Blood Dividend~

~War Fierce~.Effect:
Once per Turn, certain attacks may become {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')}. {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} attacks deal +1d4 Damage.
Choose your Fierce Craft from below!
~War Fierce~.Upgrade: You may change your Fierce Craft inbetween Adventures.
~War Fierce~.Name: ~War Fierce~

~Command - Resist~.Effect:
Use when another Ally would take Damage.
They don't take the Damage now. They take it at the end of their Turn.
~Command - Resist~.Notes: You can use dice and put them on their Hero Sheet to track that they will take the Damage later.
~Command - Resist~.Name: ~Command - Resist~

~Raise and Roil~.Effect: Single-Stun all Enemies you have hit with your Fierce Craft this Combat.
~Raise and Roil~.Combo: A ~Combo~ed Unit affected is also Slowed.
~Raise and Roil~.Name: ~Raise and Roil~
~Raise and Roil~.Notes:
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.

~Command - Charge~.Effect: Choose a direction. You and all Allies may move up to 3 meters in that direction.
~Command - Charge~.Name: ~Command - Charge~

~Rending Edge~.Requirement: Only works if target can bleed
~Rending Edge~.Effect:
Make a {Type} {A}Action Point weapon attack. It deals -50% Damage, but applies a Bleed effect on the target.
While Bleeding, it takes {Amount} True Damage at the end of your Turns.
~Rending Edge~.Notes: Remember which enemies have how much Bleed.
~Rending Edge~.Name: ~Rending Edge~

~Whirlwind~.Upgrade: The Ability is Whirlwind if a melee weapon is equipped, or Rain Death if a ranged weapon is equipped.
~Whirlwind~.Notes:
Each rolled die ^must^ be assigned to a Unit.
The Damage type depends on the weapon currently equipped. Doesn't apply weapon effects (the weapon only matters for the Damage type).

Variants.Name: Rain Death
Variants.Area: in a chosen 4x4 meter area (5 meter range to the edge).

~Whirlwind~.Name: ~Whirlwind~

~Break Mountains~.Effect:
Pick up an object 1x1x1 to 2x2x2 meters in size, and Slam it 6d6 meters in any direction.
{CriticalStrike} for each max die rolled, deal +1d6 Damage and, if it's an object, it breaks on impact!
~Break Mountains~.Upgrade: You can instead pick up an enemy and Slam it a number of meters equal to half the rolled dice.
~Break Mountains~.Notes: When something Slammed it hits a Unit, they both takes Damage equal to the number of meters left.
~Break Mountains~.Name: ~Break Mountains~

<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Effect:
When you get this, choose a Font Spell that costs 1 {Mana}Mana from any Magic Font, up to your Level.
That Ability becomes a ^physical version of itself^: instead of using magic to cast that Spell, you use your body, weapons, or tools! Be creative with how it works!
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Upgrade: The Damage of that Spell becomes Slash, Smash or Pierce, whichever makes sense.
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Notes:
E.g. Scorching Rays - you shoot 3 arrows with your bow (Pierce Damage). Be creative, come up with a description of how it works!
You can change this Ability inbetween Adventures.
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Name: <MIGHT OVER MAGIC>

~Flurry of Blades~.Effect: Your next {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} attack has {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} applied twice, and also deals the {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} Damage to all other Enemies within 2 meters of the main target.
~Flurry of Blades~.Name: ~Flurry of Blades~

~Command - Patience~.Effect: Count the Round number. A Unit you can see gains that many Shieldings that can block 3 Damage each.
~Command - Patience~.Name: ~Command - Patience~

<Quick Maneuvers>.Effect: Immediately after you make a weapon attack, choose one effect to apply.
SingleTable: Taunt a Unit you can see (that can see you)
<Quick Maneuvers>.Notes: Taunted means its next offensive Act has Cover if it's not on you.
<Quick Maneuvers>.Name: <Quick Maneuvers>

~Bull Rush~.Effect: If you move at least 3 meters in a straight line and then Attack a Unit in front of you on the same line, the Attack gains +1 for every 3 meters moved in that line.
~Bull Rush~.Notes: Works if mounted or if using Abilities that dash or jump (in a straight line), but teleporting interrupts this.
~Bull Rush~.Name: ~Bull Rush~

~Colossal Strikes~.Effect:
Each _consecutive_ {Type} weapon attack or single-target Ability on the same Unit deals {Amount} to both you and the target for each previous consecutive attack you made on that Unit.
~Click on the Icon to select which variant you want to have have!~
~Colossal Strikes~.Combo: Any of your attacks consume the ~Combo~ to not Damage you!
~Colossal Strikes~.Notes:
Consecutive attacks mean that you haven't attacked another target. For example, say you attack a Goblin this Turn. Then you attack it again, and this attack deals +1d4 to you and the Goblin. Next Turn, you attack the Goblin again and deal +2d4 Damage, to you and it. If you now attack a different target, that consecutiveness resets back to baseline (no extra Damage). Even if you attack the Goblin again, you have to repeat the cycle.
Moving or using non-single-target Abilities does _not_ break the consecutiveness.
~Colossal Strikes~.Name: ~Colossal Strikes~

~Weaponmaster~.Effect: If your {Type} {A}Action Point weapon attack can't Critical Strike, it gains the following effect.
~Weaponmaster~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you rolled maximum on at least one die, deal {Amount} Damage.
~Weaponmaster~.Name: ~Weaponmaster~

<Run Towards Glory>.Effect:
When Worthy Combat starts, a _Glory Point_ appears directly behind the furthermost Enemy from you.
The first time you reach the _Glory Point_, Heal for 1d10.
<Run Towards Glory>.Notes: The Glory Point is just a space/zone.
<Run Towards Glory>.Name: <Run Towards Glory>

~Thicker Than Water~.Requirement: Can only trigger in Worthy Combat
~Thicker Than Water~.Effect: Whenever you take Damage on your Turn, deal 50% of that to the last Unit you attacked as Fire Damage.
~Thicker Than Water~.Name: ~Thicker Than Water~

~Lead Commander~.Requirement: Can only trigger in Worthy Combat
~Lead Commander~.Effect: Whenever you use a Command Ability, give yourself or an affected Unit one Shielding that can block 1d6 Damage.
~Lead Commander~.Name: ~Lead Commander~

~Execute~.Effect:
Your next weapon attack kills the target if it leaves it with at most 1 {Health}Health.
If it dies, increase that number by +1 permanently.
~Execute~.Notes: Remind the Quest Master about this Ability when you think the enemy should die.
~Execute~.Name: ~Execute~

<Opportunity Attack>.Effect:
Use when an enemy within 1 meter moves away from you or makes a Ranged attack.
Make a {1AP} weapon attack on it.
<Opportunity Attack>.Upgrade: You can quickly equip a {1AP} weapon and attack with it.
<Opportunity Attack>.Name: <Opportunity Attack>

~Chainwaver~.Effect: Slam a Unit 1d8 meters towards another Unit that isn't near it.
~Chainwaver~.Downside: At the end of the Turn you used this, it goes on Cooldown until the next Combat.
~Chainwaver~.Notes: You can Slam yourself! Or another Unit into you. You can use this as many times as you want, but all uses must be on the same Turn.
~Chainwaver~.Name: ~Chainwaver~

~Division and Conquest~.Effect:
Choose a Unit within your {Type} ^weapon^'s Range and spend all your remaining {A}Action Points.
For each spent, Damage them for {Amount} (weapon's Damage Type) and inflict a random Control Effect from below:
~Division and Conquest~.Upgrade: 1. Lagged, 2.Deafened, 3. Dazed, 4.Single-Stunned, 5. Slowed, 6. Blinded, 7. Crippled, 8. Silenced, 9. Rooted, 10. Frailed.
~Division and Conquest~.Notes:
Epic Units can't be Silenced or Rooted, and instead become Deafened or Lagged respectively.
A Lagged Unit's next Movement costs +1 Action Point.
A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.

A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -100% Damage/Healing.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.
~Division and Conquest~.Name: ~Division and Conquest~

<Intercept>.Effect:
Dash towards a Unit.
Slam it away from you a number of meters equal to how many meters you just dashed.
<Intercept>.Name: <Intercept>

<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Effect:
When you get this, choose ~two~ Class Talents that cost 1 {Mana}Mana from (any Specialization of) Cleric, Mage or Warlock, up to your Level.
Those Abilities become ^physical versions of themselves^: instead of using magic to cast that spell, you use your body/weapons/tools!
<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Upgrade: The Damage of that Spell becomes Slash, Smash or Pierce, whichever makes sense.
<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Notes:
E.g. Scorching Rays - you shoot 3 arrows with your bow (Pierce Damage). Be creative, come up with a description of how it works!
You can change this Ability inbetween Adventures.
<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Name: <MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>

~Command - Focus Fire~.Effect:
Choose a target and spend any number of {A}Action Points.
For each spent, command another Ally (all different) in your party to make a 1 {A}Action Point Act on that target.
~Command - Focus Fire~.Name: ~Command - Focus Fire~

~Groundbreaker~.Effect: When falling, your impact makes a crater a number of meters in diameter equal to the fallen distance, 2 meters deep at the edges, and Damages all other Units caught in the crater for your Falling Damage taken.
~Groundbreaker~.Notes: Only triggers if you take Falling Damage.

~Heavenbreaker~.Effect:
Spend any number of Action Points.
For each spent, Slam yourself 1d8 meters upward.
~Heavenbreaker~.Upgrade: If you went above 10 meters up into the air, you land at the start of your next Turn.

~Groundbreaker~.Name: ~Groundbreaker~

~Breathing Technique~.Effect: You can breathe underwater for up to 1d20 minutes and swim at your normal speed.
~Breathing Technique~.Name: ~Breathing Technique~

<Overthrow>.Effect: When you Slam a Unit into a wall, it becomes Single-Stunned instead of taking Damage.
<Overthrow>.Name: <Overthrow>
<Overthrow>.Notes: A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~Command - Formation~.Effect: All Allies within 10 meters immediately move to form one of these formations with you:
List: Line: line with no space between Units!
V: V with no space between Units!
Box: equilateral square, extra Units in the middle!
~Command - Formation~.Name: ~Command - Formation~

~Hex Magic~.Effect:
After you cast a Spell, you can expend 5 Health to force it to _echo_.
You can expend 3 Health to add or subtract 1d6 from any other Unit's roll (not yours).
~Hex Magic~.Notes:
The QM might not roll Damage for monsters, and instead take the average - even if they take the average, that counts as a roll.
Keep in mind you only have 1 Reaction per Round.
~Hex Magic~.Name: ~Hex Magic~

~Day Night Cycle~.Effect:
You are always in either {Orange('Solar')} or {Purple('Lunar')} stance, based on the _period of day_ (see gray text).

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: you have +3 Health Regen and can cast any Ability Shapeshifted.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: once per attack/Ability/animal feature, when you roll maximum on a die, roll one more.
~Day Night Cycle~.Notes:
{Orange('Solar Stance')} period is from 6:00 to 18:00. {Purple('Lunar Stance')} period is from 18:00 to 6:00.
Your stance may change during combat. {Orange('Solar Stance')} Health Regen applies if you end the combat in Solar Stance.
If the campaign setting somehow skewes the day/night cycle, the Quest Master should find a different criterion to determine day/night.
~Day Night Cycle~.Name: ~Day Night Cycle~

~Another Effect~.Effect: Each Day Ability increases your Damage and Healing by 1. After triggering 50%, switch to Night.
~Another Effect~.Name: ~Another Effect~

~Moonsun Fire~.Effect: {Orange('Solar Stance')}: Damage an enemy for 1d4 + ^Any Stat^ (Fire), then Heal an ally for the same amount.
~Moonsun Fire~.Name: ~Moonsun Fire~

~Venin Shot~.Effect:
A target takes 1d8 + ^Presence^ Poison Damage.
The _next time_ it takes damage from a weapon, it takes an extra 1d8 Poison Damage.
~Venin Shot~.Combo: The next time Damage happens now instead.
~Venin Shot~.Name: ~Venin Shot~

~Fog Cloud~.Effect: A 5x5x5 meter cube becomes covered in fog for 1 minute.
~Fog Cloud~.Upgrade: All Attacks done from, through or to Units inside Fog have Cover (-50%).
~Fog Cloud~.Notes: Fog can be dissipated by wind. You can choose the color of the fog. The fog does not go through walls, but does bend around corners (e.g. up to 360 degrees around wall extremities).
~Fog Cloud~.Name: ~Fog Cloud~

~Burnished Flames~.Effect: Deal 1d12 + ^Presence^ Damage (Fire if {Orange('Solar')}, Scourge if {Purple('Lunar')}) and apply a ~Combo~.
~Burnished Flames~.Name: ~Burnished Flames~

~Curse of Locusts~.Effect:
A swarm of locusts appears and chases a Unit you can see for 1 minute.

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Whenever it makes a Move Act, it takes 1d4 Poison Damage.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: For every Act not spent Moving, it takes 1d4 Acid Damage
~Curse of Locusts~.Name: ~Curse of Locusts~

~Effigy of Warding~.Cooldown: Up to 1 effigy placed at a time
~Effigy of Warding~.Effect:
Place an effigy in a space. It triggers an effect when a Unit comes within 2 meters of it:
If Enemy, it takes +50% Damage next time it takes Damage.
If Ally, it takes -50% Damage next time it takes Damage.
~Effigy of Warding~.Upgrade: Does not trigger if the Unit was already there.
~Effigy of Warding~.Name: ~Effigy of Warding~

~Solunar Psyche Blast~.Effect:
A Unit takes 3d6 Psychic Damage and:

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: it becomes Blinded or Silenced (your choice).

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: An ally within 3 meters is healed for 50% of the Damage dealt.
~Solunar Psyche Blast~.Name: ~Solunar Psyche Blast~
~Solunar Psyche Blast~.Notes:
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.

~Improved Moonsun Fire~.Effect:
{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Damage ~and Root~ an enemy for 1d4 + ^Any Stat^ (Fire), then Heal an ally for the same amount.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Damage ~and Single-Stun~ or Heal a Unit for ~2d4~ + ^Any Stat^ (Pulse) and apply a ~Combo~. The next ~Combo~ on that Unit triggers twice!
~Improved Moonsun Fire~.Name: ~Improved Moonsun Fire~
~Improved Moonsun Fire~.Notes:
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.

<Daybreak-Nightfall>.Effect: When you pass from day to night and viceversa, roll 1d4 and gain one of these boons.
SingleTable: 3. Your next Spell costs -1 Action Point
<Daybreak-Nightfall>.Name: <Daybreak-Nightfall>

<Forced Eclipse>.Effect:
By weather-wight and star-song, I bid the sun forth and call the moon to reign!
Force 1 minute of artificial day or night in a 1km area around you.
<Forced Eclipse>.Upgrade: This can reset the Cooldown of Moonsun Fire's, once when it happens, and again when it ends.
<Forced Eclipse>.Notes: Nothing happens if used with Equinox.
<Forced Eclipse>.Name: <Forced Eclipse>

~Love and Lust~.Effect:
At the end of the Adventure, if most of your time was spent in a certain stance this Adventure, gain a permanent bonus:

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Gain a Skill.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Gain an extra positive Quirk.
~Love and Lust~.Upgrade: These effects are permanent, even after you no longer have this Talent.
~Love and Lust~.Name: ~Love and Lust~

<Voodoo Magic>.Effect:
A Unit within 6 meters makes a Presence Check.
If it fails, it takes 2d6 Psychic Damage at the start of your every turn for 1 minute, and for its next turn, you can choose that enemy's Acts as long as it would seem reasonable to that enemy (decide with your QM).
Epic Monsters can not be controlled; they only take the Damage.
<Voodoo Magic>.Notes: For example, you can make a goblin run or recklessly attack one of your party members. But you can't make a guard jump off a cliff, because that's not what it would normally do.
<Voodoo Magic>.Name: <Voodoo Magic>

<Corpseblast>.Effect:
Use the moment a Worthy Unit dies.
Explode the corpse, dealing 1d4 Poison Damage to all Units near it.
Heal for the Damage dealt.
<Corpseblast>.Name: <Corpseblast>

<Blood Brew>.Effect:
You spend 10 minutes creating a strange splashable brew made from your own blood, with a random effect.
The brew can be splashed (1 {A}Action Point) onto a Unit (at 3 meters range).
When you create it, roll 1d4 to determine its effect.
You are immune to Blood Brews.
<Blood Brew>.Notes: The brews lose their effect at the end of the Adventure. Acid and Muck ignore real Cover.

Values: Target takes 1d8 Damage and becomes Blinded
Deals 1d12 Damage in a 5x5 area centered on the target, and a Toxic Gas cloud forms there.

<Blood Brew>.Name: <Blood Brew>

<Bone Mass>.Effect:
Declare a square area with a diameter equal to the Health spent.
Sharp bones grow from the area (occupying 1x1 meters each).
When a Unit steps on a Sharp Bone, it directly takes 1d8 Pierce Damage and loses 1 meter of its remaining speed.
The bone then shatters.
<Bone Mass>.Name: <Bone Mass>

<Star Fall>.Effect:
{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Heal a Unit for 6d12.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Damage a Unit for 6d10 True Damage.
<Star Fall>.Name: <Star Fall>

~Eclipsis Penumbrae~.Effect: For 1 hour, you are both in {Orange('Solar Stance')} and {Purple('Lunar Stance')}. Both effects apply.
~Eclipsis Penumbrae~.Name: ~Eclipsis Penumbrae~

~Zodiac Alignment~.Effect:
Declare a 4x4 meter area.

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Deal Fire Damage to all Units caught equal to the number of empty spaces in the area.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Declare 1 animal feature. Shapeshift all Units caught into an animal with that feature for their next Turn.
~Zodiac Alignment~.Notes: The Damage is dealt all at once, not 1 by 1. Shapeshifted Units can not do their regular Abilities and can't cancel the effect. They remain Shapeshifted until the end of their (next) Turn.
~Zodiac Alignment~.Name: ~Zodiac Alignment~

~Consummation~.Effect:
{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Eat a non-Epic, Large or smaller Unit. While inside you, they are Blinded and Rooted to you and can only target you. {Color('red' 'Only usable while Shapeshifted')}.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: You and a chosen Unit are bound in exile, banished together into the Celestial Veil until the end of their (next) Turn. It is Single-Stunned and Slowed. Your Turn ends immediately after casting this Spell.

You can only target each Unit Once / Encounter.
~Consummation~.Notes:
Whilst beneath the Celestial Veil, no hand nor spell may pass between banished ones and the waking world. Yet to mortal sight, those who walk the Celestial Realm are glimpsed faintly, as wraith-shadows drifting at the edge of vision.
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.
~Consummation~.Name: ~Consummation~

~Primal Form~.Effect:
Your animal forms become improved and more akin to feral or primal animals, with larger fur, longer claws, thicker horns or even glowing eyes, depending on your stance.

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: You can pick one additional animal feature when Shapeshifting.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: You deal +1 Damage (from all source) and have +1 Movement Speed while Shapeshifted.
~Primal Form~.Name: ~Primal Form~

~Blessing of Yune~.Effect:
You weave a Blessing of Yune upon a willing ally whose spirit is clean and mind at ease, binding their soul to the turning of the sun and moon forever, while you have this Talent.

That ally now has the Day Night Cycle Ability, permanently.
~Blessing of Yune~.Notes: Once blessed, they are bound by celestial worship until death. Should they be reborn anew, you may bestow the blessing upon someone else.
~Blessing of Yune~.Name: ~Blessing of Yune~

<Sunrise/Moonfall>.Effect: Moonsun Fire now hits one extra target, deals 1d4 extra Damage and ignores Defense and Resistances.
<Sunrise/Moonfall>.Name: <Sunrise/Moonfall>

<Equinox>.Effect: Your next Spell (this Turn or next) casts twice.
<Equinox>.Upgrade: If you use this with Shapeshift, you can combine into 2 animals, and have both their Abilities and their highest Stats.
<Equinox>.Notes: On the second cast, you can choose different targets, areas, etc (and it ignores Cooldown, Costs, etc).
<Equinox>.Name: <Equinox>

<Dead Hands>.Effect:
Declare a square area with a diameter equal to the Health spent.
Undead hands appear in that area and make it Hard Terrain.
At the start of your next turn, summon a number of Draugr equal to half the Health spent, each wherever you choose in that area.

Monster.Name: Draugr
Monster.Description: Draugr take their turn the same time as you and you can command them to do move and attack. They can not do Default Moves or use items. Draugr last for 10 minutes or until killed.

~Attack~.Effect: Make a melee attack for 1d4 Scourge Damage.

<Dead Hands>.Name: <Dead Hands>
<Dead Hands>.Notes: Moving 1 meter through Hard Terrain takes 2 meters of Movement.

<Schizophrenic Suggestion>.Effect:
Declare a square area with a diameter equal to ^twice the Health spent^.
All Units in that area must succeed a Presence Check agasint _twice the Health spent_ or instantly make an attack or offensive Ability of its choice, at full strength, on its closest ally.
<Schizophrenic Suggestion>.Notes: Monsters can use any of their Abilities that do Control Effects, and target them however they want if they are Area Abilities, as long as it hits its closest ally.
<Schizophrenic Suggestion>.Name: <Schizophrenic Suggestion>

<Bumboclaat!>.Effect:
Target a Unit.
The next time it would take Damage from any source before your next turn, the Damage is increased by 100%.
<Bumboclaat!>.Upgrade: You can only use this on targets that have blood.
<Bumboclaat!>.Notes: Applies to added extra Damage if it's the same type as the base Damage (e.g. Advanced Flank works, but not Smites).
<Bumboclaat!>.Name: <Bumboclaat!>

~Portal~.Effect:
Start conjuring a portal at your location resembling the nature of your specialization and studies.
Think of an exact destination within 1000km.
At the end of the cast time, a portal opens at this location and the destination.
~Portal~.Notes:
At the end of the spell, the destination must be empty for the portal to appear there. Otherwise the portal spell is cancelled and goes on a 1 real hour Cooldown.
Stepping through one of the portals (obviously) teleports the Unit to the other portal.
~Portal~.Name: ~Portal~

~Barkskin~.Effect:
An ally you can see (or yourself) becomes Rooted in the ground.
While rooted, that Unit's Defense can't be lower than 5.
Lasts until that Unit moves from place.
~Barkskin~.Name: ~Barkskin~
~Barkskin~.Notes: A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.

~Spectral Hand~.Effect:
You have a spectral, ghostly hand that levitates around you within 5 meters and is invisible when resting.
You can manipulate and move the hand as you do your own, spending {A}Action Points or Movement.
The hand can't attack, but it can cast Spells as if from your own hand.
~Spectral Hand~.Notes:
The hand can't deal Damage or go more than 5 meters away from you.
The hand can't lift objects weighing more than 10kg.
Moving the hand spends Actions as if you made moved your own hand.
Once / turn, you can summon or vanish the hand for 0 {A}Action Points if it's effect is still active, in a space next to you.
~Spectral Hand~.Name: ~Spectral Hand~

~Grow or Shrink~.Effect:
A Unit or object you can see becomes one Size larger/smaller for its next 1d4 turns.
It gains or loses 1 Deense, gains or loses 1 Damage on all physical Acts (that would deal Damage) and gains or loses 1 Movement Speed.
Can stack multiple times.
~Grow or Shrink~.Notes:
Sizes are Minuscule, Small, Medium, Large, and Larger.
A larger Unit becomes 1 meter larger/smaller in both directions.
It's number of spaces occupied also changes with this.
~Grow or Shrink~.Name: ~Grow or Shrink~

~Spell Book~.Effect: After each Worthy Combat, if you have 50% or less {Mana}Mana, replenish 1 {Mana}Mana.
~Spell Book~.Upgrade:
You have a special Spell Book which you draw your power from. The effect applies while carrying the book.
If you ever lose it, you can spend 1 day and 100 {Gold}Gold to recreate it.
~Spell Book~.Name: ~Spell Book~

~Magic Font~.Effect: You may select a Magic Font to pick Spells from. You can pick a number of Font Spells equal to your Focus.
~Magic Font~.Notes: You can change your chosen Magic Font (and Font Spells) inbetween Adventures.
~Magic Font~.Name: ~Magic Font~

~Comprehension~.Effect:
When you unlock a Talent tier, you may forgo getting a Talent from that tier to instead pick an extra Talent from a lower-Level tier or an extra Magic Font Spell.

Additionally, you may forgo a getting a Magic Font Spell to instead pick an extra Talent that costs {Mana}Mana (within your Level).
~Comprehension~.Name: ~Comprehension~

~Learn Scrolls~.Effect: If you have a Scroll that contains an Ability that costs {Mana}Mana within your Level, you can destroy it to learn it permanently (without taking a Talent slot).
~Learn Scrolls~.Notes: YouOf course, you still need to spend {Mana}Mana and respect the Cooldown of said Ability.
~Learn Scrolls~.Name: ~Learn Scrolls~

~Control Elements~.Notes:
{ElementNotes}
Apply common sense. The QM has the final word on whether something is possible.

Variants.DoWhat:
Target a 2x2x2 meter cube containing Fire.
Choose any of the following to do with it:
{Diamond} Move it up to 5 meters in any direction
{Diamond} Extinguish it
{Diamond} Lower or increase its intensity or light emission by 50%
{Diamond} Roughly alter its shape and/or color
Variants.ElementNotes: A Unit that touches the fire takes 2 Damage.

Variants.DoWhat:
Target a 1 meter cube containing Water.
Choose any of the following to do with it:
{Diamond} Move it up to 5 meters in any direction
{Diamond} Destroy it
{Diamond} Lower or increase its temperature down to near-freezing or near-boiling
{Diamond} Roughly its shape and/or color
Variants.ElementNotes: Water is Hard Terrain. A Unit that touches near-boiling or near-freezing water takes 2 Damage.

~Control Elements~.Name: ~Control Elements~

~Magic Tricks~.Effect:
Choose one of these effects to cast:
{Diamond} Create harmless sensory effects, sparks or non-damaging heat or cold.
{Diamond} Channel to create simple, small, harmless illusions in your hand or within 3 meters.
{Diamond} Instantly clean or soil objects.
{Diamond} Control a quill with telekinesis to quickly write with it.
~Magic Tricks~.Name: ~Magic Tricks~

~Feather Fall~.Effect:
Up to 2 Units you choose will start falling gently, down to 3 meters per round.
Once the fall finishes, the spell effect ends.
~Feather Fall~.Notes:
Arcane Feathers can be bought in most towns.
For faster gameplay, you can spend 10 gold when casting the spell, and buy the feather later.
~Feather Fall~.Name: ~Feather Fall~

~Teleportation~.Effect: Instantly teleport up to 5 meters away, within line of sight.
~Teleportation~.Notes:
Does not work if you're Rooted or stuck in place somehow. You take with you all items carried you want, but not other Units.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.
~Teleportation~.Name: ~Teleportation~

~Verticalism~.Effect:
Tapping into the arcane knowledge and the materials in the ground beneath, spend 1000 {Gold}Gold to conjure a permanent stone tower up to 40 meters tall and 12 meters across, decorated as you like. The insides are currently empty, but while you have this Ability, you may spend 1 minute to teleport any non-alive item you can hold to any location in your tower.
While you have this Ability, if within 100 kilometers of the tower, you can channel for 1 hour to teleport your party to it.
~Verticalism~.Name: ~Verticalism~

~Extension~.Effect:
Magically extend the weapon of a willing ally you can see to up to 3 meters.
Its Attacks with that weapon can have up to 3 meters range, and still count as Melee.
~Extension~.Name: ~Extension~

~Inscription~.Effect:
Cast a Spell onto a _scroll_, spending its Cost, Cooldown, {A}Action Points, etc (plus the additional 1 {Mana}Mana for this Ability).
The _scroll_ can be used with 1 {A}Action Point, and is destroyed after being used.
~Inscription~.Name: ~Inscription~

~Animated Weapon~.Effect:
Summon a levitating, self-wielding melee weapon on a space within 3 meters.
It has 1 {A}Action Point that can only be spent for Move and Attack,
It takes its Turn on at the same time as you, but disappears if it doesn't attack an Enemy or Worthy Unit by the end of your Turn.

~Move and Attack~.Effect: Move up to its Speed (or not), then Attack an Enemy for 2d8 Damage (Pierce, Slash or Smash).
~Move and Attack~.Upgrade: If the weapon doesn't make an attack on an Enemy or Worthy Unit by the end of your Turn, it is unsummoned.

~Animated Weapon~.Name: ~Animated Weapon~

~Magic Rune~.Effect:
Magically draw a faint 3x3 meter _rune_ onto a flat surface.
Cast a Spell onto the _rune_, spending its Cost, Cooldown, {A}Action Points, etc (plus the additional 1 {Mana}Mana for this Ability).
When an Enemy enters the _rune_, that Spell is automatically cast on that Unit (or centered on that Unit if it's an Area Ability). Then the _rune_ is destroyed.
~Magic Rune~.Notes: If the Spell has you choose something else, like a secondary target or an effect, you can do so the moment the rune explodes.
~Magic Rune~.Name: ~Magic Rune~

~Expansionism~.Effect: Gain access to one more Magic Font to pick Spells from.
~Expansionism~.Name: ~Expansionism~

<Pyromancy>.Effect: Every Turn, after the first time you deal Damage to 2 or more Enemies with the same Ability, increase all Fire Damage you deal by 1 for the rest of the combat.
<Pyromancy>.Notes: This extra Damage is applied as normal extra Damage, before any other calculations.
<Pyromancy>.Name: <Pyromancy>

<Electromancy>.Effect: After the first time you affect an Ally with a Spell each Turn, increase all Healing, Shieldings, and Shock Damage you do by 1 for the rest of the Combat.
<Electromancy>.Notes: This extra Damage is applied as normal extra Damage, before any other calculations.
<Electromancy>.Name: <Electromancy>

<Arcanism>.Effect:
Your and your summons' dice can't roll less than 0 (see below).
After every 5 rolled dice, increase that number by 1 this Combat.
<Arcanism>.Notes: If a die rolled less than that number, set the die's result to that number. The number of rolled dice carry on to the next Turn. This number can even exceed a die's highest number. If that happens, no longer roll the die and just take the number and does not count as a die roll.
<Arcanism>.Name: <Arcanism>

<Hydromancy>.Effect: Once per Turn, after you apply a Control Effect to an Enemy, increase all Cold Damage you deal by 1 for the rest of the combat.
<Hydromancy>.Notes: This extra Damage is applied as normal extra Damage, before any other calculations. Slamming counts as a Control Effect.
<Hydromancy>.Name: <Hydromancy>

~Book Is Alive!~.Effect:
Your spell book is animated and alive, and levitates around you!
It has only 1 {A}Action Point on its Turn that it can only use to move and on its own Abilities.
You can cast Spells as if they originate from the book, calculating Range and Cover from it instead of you.
~Book Is Alive!~.Upgrade: The book may participate in Combat but won't be Damaged unless purposefully targeted.
~Book Is Alive!~.Notes:
"Alive" is a strange term... no one is quite sure whether it is simply animated, sentient, or conscious... but if it looks like a book and acts like a book, then it's probably a book.
The book can do Checks with its own or your own Stats and bonuses.

~Turn Invisible~.Effect: The book turns invisible for as long as its master holds their breath.

~Grab~.Effect:
Grab, drop, or manipulate an object.
If holding one, it can use a non-Wizard Scroll or Potion.
~Grab~.Notes: Can hold up to 1 object at a tine.

~Book Is Alive!~.Name: ~Book Is Alive!~

~Upcast~.Effect: After you cast the next Spell this Turn, choose one of the rolled dice. Increase the result number of that die by 100%.
~Upcast~.Upgrade: This is not considered a Spell.
~Upcast~.Name: ~Upcast~

~Volumency~.Effect:
A Unit or object you can see becomes one Size ^larger^/_smaller_.
It ^gains^/_loses_ 10% Max Health, ^gains^/_loses_ 1 Damage on all offensive Acts, and ^gains^/_loses_ 1 Movement Speed.
Can stack multiple times on Non-Epic Units.
~Volumency~.Notes:
Current Health changes with the Max Health (e.g. for 80/100 Health, if growing, new Health will be 90/110; if shrinking, new Health will be 70/90). When the effect expires, the new Current Health stays as it is, unless it's higher than the new Max Health.
When the effect expires, current Health remains the same if lower, or is cut to maximum if higher.
A larger Unit becomes 1 meter larger/smaller in both directions.
It's number of spaces occupied also changes with this.
~Volumency~.Name: ~Volumency~

~Immensity of Knowledge~.Effect: You can access Magic Font Spells 2 Levels earlier than the required Level.
~Immensity of Knowledge~.Upgrade: If you have Learn Scrolls, this also decreases the Level required by that Spell by 2.
~Immensity of Knowledge~.Name: ~Immensity of Knowledge~

~Warding~.Effect:
Choose a non-physical Damage Type. A Unit you can see becomes surrounded in an aura of that Type.
The next time they take Damage of that Type, they take -100% Damage, and that Damage is dealt to all Units within 1 meter of it.
~Warding~.Name: ~Warding~

~Elemental Enchantment~.Effect:
Choose a metallic weapon to imbue it with {Element}.
It {Eff} and the total Damage becomes {Element} Damage.
~Elemental Enchantment~.Upgrade: Lasts until the end of the next (or current) combat, or the end of the Adventure.
~Elemental Enchantment~.Notes: Does not stack with other temporary weapon enchantments from Spells.

Variants.Name: Frost
Variants.Eff: Slows the target of attacks with it

Variants.Name: Electric
Variants.Eff: also deals 1d2 Shock Damage (or 1d6 for Two-Handed weapons) to a different Unit within 3 meters of the target

~Elemental Enchantment~.Name: ~Elemental Enchantment~

<Abjuration>.Effect:
Use on a physical missile that is flying (e.g. an arrow, a canonball, etc).
Quickly decelerate it so it falls to the ground.
<Abjuration>.Notes: Does not work if the missile is a Unit.
<Abjuration>.Name: <Abjuration>

~Fusionism~.Effect: When you cast a Font Spell, you may change its Damage to Fire, Cold, Shock, or Pulse, and treat it as belonging to another Font.
~Fusionism~.Name: ~Fusionism~

<Spellcraft>.Effect:
When you or another Unit you can see casts a Spell, you can apply this any of the following effects to it:
{Diamond} Double its range
{Diamond} Change its Damage Type to any Type
{Diamond} Increase or decrease its Area by 50% (if any)
{Diamond} Change its Control Effect to another base* Control Effect
<Spellcraft>.Notes:
Base Control Effects are Single-Control Effects listed in the Rules (e.g. not Double-Stun, Polymorph, etc).
A Double-Stunned Unit has -2 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
<Spellcraft>.Name: <Spellcraft>

~Anachronism~.Effect:
Use after you roll dice.
You have exactly 15 seconds to reroll all dice until you're happy with the result. If you end with dice in hand when the timer expires, they count as 0.
~Anachronism~.Name: ~Anachronism~

~Polymorph~.Effect:
Choose a Unit and spend any number of {A}Action Points and {Mana}Mana (at least 1 of each).
You shapeshift it into an animal shape you choose.
It has a number of features equal to the {Mana}Mana spent, and lasts until it has spent a number of {A}Action Points equal to the {A}Action Points spent.
It can do everything it normally can, but the features block certain actions.
~Polymorph~.Upgrade: Apply all other rules for Druid's Shapeshift Ability.

~Heavy Animal Attack~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you roll maximum, apply a ~Combo~.

~Polymorph~.Notes: Stuns and other similar hard Control Effects count as losing {A}Action Points for this effect.

SpellTable.Name: Pedestrian
SpellTable.Effect: Perpetually Slowed or has +50% Movement Speed (you choose).

SpellTable.Name: Pusillanimous
SpellTable.Effect: Its Heavy Animal Attack deals only 1d4 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Imbecile
SpellTable.Effect: Can not use Abilities.

SpellTable.Name: Effete
SpellTable.Effect: Can not attack with real weapons.

SpellTable.Name: Impotent
SpellTable.Effect: Its non-resistance passives and weapon effects are disabled.

SpellTable.Name: Resizized
SpellTable.Effect: Make its size 1 size Smaller or Larger (you can choose this multiple times).

SpellTable.Name: Maladapted
SpellTable.Effect: Its Damage resistances and weaknesses are negated.

SpellTable.Name: Emerging
SpellTable.Effect: Can fly, swim, and does not need to breathe.

~Polymorph~.Name: ~Polymorph~

<Animation>.Effect:
Whenever you spend {Mana}Mana on a Spell that doesn't deal Damage, you can pick a Medium or Large object within 6 meters and bring it to life.
It has 3 Speed, can fly and can attack for 1d4 Smash, Slash or Pierce Damage.
Lasts 1 minute or until it takes Damage (after which it returns to its inanimate form).
<Animation>.Notes: Alternatively, it can use Sprint, Push or Taunt once.
<Animation>.Name: <Animation>

~Invisibility~.Effect:
Use on your Turn, or before a Unit wants to do something.
Choose a Unit you can see. It becomes invisible for up to 1 minute, or until it does an offensive Act.
~Invisibility~.Upgrade: You can spend extra {Mana}Mana to extend the duration of this by that many minutes.
~Invisibility~.Name: ~Invisibility~

<Contraspell>.Effect:
Use when a Unit you can see wants to cast a Spell.
It doesn't, and loses the {A}Action Points and {Mana}Mana they would have spent on it.
<Contraspell>.Notes: The Spell does not go on Cooldown, since it wasn't really cast.
<Contraspell>.Name: <Contraspell>

~Levitate~.Effect:
First, roll 2d100 (_or 4d100*_). That's how many kilograms (_or *pounds_) you can levitate when you cast this.
Levitate one object or Unit you can see and move it as you like as long as it is and remains within 10 meters of you.
On each of your Turns, you can spend 2 {A}Action Points to keep the Object levitated or move it again. Otherwise, it falls slowly and the Spell ends.
~Levitate~.Upgrade:
A levitated Unit is perpetually Slowed.
At Level 9, you can levitate +100% the amount.
~Levitate~.Notes:
Lasts until you don't spend 2 {A}Action Points, or you become at least Single-Stunned.
2d100 is in kilograms and 4d100 is in pounds.

A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
~Levitate~.Name: ~Levitate~

~Major Illusion~.Effect:
You create an illusion that fits at most in a 3x3x3 meter area.
The illusion appears real to the eyes, ears and by smell, but physical interaction makes it obvious it's an illusion and objects pass through it normally.
The illusion can deal no Control Effects, but can provide Cover or block Line of Sight (both from the front, and from behind).
On your Turn, you can spend 2 {A}Action Points to keep and/or move the illusion, otherwise the Spell ends.
~Major Illusion~.Upgrade:
At Level 8, the illusion lasts indefinitely until you cancel it without needing to spend Actions, and it can hold its own simple movement and clockwork-like routines.
You can also program this illusion to react on its own in a specific way to specific triggers, but the instructions must be concise - talk with your QM about this.
~Major Illusion~.Name: ~Major Illusion~

~Conjuration~.Effect:
You can conjure an object that is up to 1x1x1 meter in size.
The object is solid and glows faintly.
You can't conjure mechanical objects.
The object disappears after 1 hour (24 hours at Level 8).
~Conjuration~.Name: ~Conjuration~

~Transmogrification~.Effect:
Touch 2 objects of the same type (e.g. 2 helmets, or 2 arrows, or 2 melee One-Handed weapons, etc).
You make one of the look like the other.
The change is permanent until the object breaks.
~Transmogrification~.Notes: Upon close inspection of the shape and colors, this is visibly an illusion.
~Transmogrification~.Name: ~Transmogrification~

~Skipper~.Effect:
Your starting Stats are 0, 0, 0, 2 (instead of -1, 0, 1, 2).
You have +1 Movement Speed.
Your minimum jumping distance is 3 meters.
~Skipper~.Notes: As part of your normal Movement, you can freely jump a number of meters equal to your Instinct, without needing a Check.
~Skipper~.Name: ~Skipper~

~Tall Paws (or Hooves)~.Effect: You are immune to being Slowed.
~Tall Paws (or Hooves)~.Name: ~Tall Paws (or Hooves)~
~Tall Paws (or Hooves)~.Notes: A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.

~Carnivore~.Effect: Eat a piece of meat to Heal yourself for 1d4. Each time you do, get -1 Presence until the end of the next Combat.
~Carnivore~.Downside:
You can not eat grains and can only lightly eat vegetables.
Exclusive with Herbivore.
~Carnivore~.Notes: If your Presence becomes -6, get -1 Instinct instead.
~Carnivore~.Name: ~Carnivore~

Extras: Half of your meals can consist of grass and leaves, but you can not eat meat.
~Herbivore~.Effect:
Gain +2 Max Health.
Half of your meals can consist of grass and leaves.
~Herbivore~.Downside:
You can not eat meat.
Exclusive with Carnivore.
~Herbivore~.Notes: If you do, you take 1d4 Damage.
~Herbivore~.Name: ~Herbivore~

~Thick Shell~.Effect: While unarmored, you take -50% Slash Damage instead of having +1 Movement Speed.
~Thick Shell~.Notes: Slash Damage reduction does not stack with Shields (e.g. Heater Shield).
~Thick Shell~.Name: ~Thick Shell~

Combat Extras: When you gain Shielding, give it +1
~Horns~.Effect: Whenever you gain Shielding, increase its value by 1.
~Horns~.Downside: You can't wear helmets (hats might fit you, though).
~Horns~.Name: ~Horns~

~Feral Claws~.EffectGreen:
Critical Strike - if you rolled minimum, apply a ~Combo~.
Critical Strike - if you rolled maximum, the target becomes Blinded.
~Feral Claws~.Notes:
Counts as a ^weapon^ attack and/or as a Punch (unarmed) attack.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Sharpen With Magic~.Effect:
Permanently sharpen your claws with a ^magic weapon^ worth at least 25 XP.
Increase the Damage of Feral Claws by +1.
The magic weapon is then destroyed.

~Feral Claws~.Name: ~Feral Claws~

~Avian Wings~.Effect:
Quickly fly up to 3 meters (e.g. almost instantly).
Passively, you don't take Falling Damage.
~Avian Wings~.Upgrade: Your arms and hands become bird-like wings, but that makes it harder for you to hold and use weapons.
~Avian Wings~.Name: ~Avian Wings~

Combat Extras: -50% Smash Damage taken at 50% or more Health
~Thick Fur~.Effect:
You take -50% Cold Damage.
You take -50% Smash Damage while at 50% or more Health.
~Thick Fur~.Name: ~Thick Fur~

Combat Bonuses: You swim at your Movement Speed + 1 meter
~Fins~.Effect:
You have +0.5 Initiative.
You can swim at your normal Movement Speed + 1 meter.
~Fins~.Name: ~Fins~

Combat Extras: Switch any Stat on Abilities/weapons to Instinct
~Aerodynamic~.Effect: In weapons or Abilities, you can switch any one Stat written on it to ^Instinct^.
~Aerodynamic~.Notes: E.g. Chilling Shout becomes 12 + ^Instinct^ instead of 12 + ^Presence^. Phase Orb becomes 2d6 + ^Instinct + Instinct^ instead of 2d6 + ^Focus + Presence^.
~Aerodynamic~.Name: ~Aerodynamic~

~All Eyes and Noses~.Effect: Make a Unit freely move 1d4 meters towards you, if able.
~All Eyes and Noses~.Notes: Does not use that Unit's {A}Action Point or Movement.
~All Eyes and Noses~.Name: ~All Eyes and Noses~

~Clacker Claw~.Name: ~Clacker Claw~
~Clacker Claw~.Notes: A Double-Stunned Unit has -2 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

Combat Extras: Once per Turn, use a Potion/Scroll with 0 AP.
~Eleff Nose~.Effect: Once per Turn, you can use a Potion or Scroll with 0 {A}Action Points.
~Eleff Nose~.Name: ~Eleff Nose~

~Bristly Back~.Effect:
Use when attacked from behind.
Deal 1d4 Pierce Damage to the attacker.
~Bristly Back~.Upgrade: Alternatively, gain 1 _bristle_ instead of dealing Damage. You can spend {A}1 {A}Action Point to shoot all _bristles_ each into a Unit behind you for 1d4 Damage.
~Bristly Back~.Notes: Bristles last until the end of Adventure. On your Turn, you can turn any direction for free.
~Bristly Back~.Name: ~Bristly Back~

~Stouthearten~.Effect:
You have +100% Inventory capacity.
You can wear an extra layer of Light or Medium armor over (or underneath) your armor. Apply all of its effects as normal.
~Stouthearten~.Notes: Unarmored is not an armor. 50% Damage reductions of the same type do not stack
~Stouthearten~.Name: ~Stouthearten~

~Forgeborn~.Effect:
Spend 1 hour at a forge while in a friendly town to craft an artisanal Two-Handed weapon or an armor, that's made of metal.
Spend {Gold}Gold equal the item's base cost + 100.
If it's a Two-Handed weapon, it deals +1 Damage. If it's an armor, its wearer has +2 Max Health.
~Forgeborn~.Upgrade: For example, you can't craft padded armor, robes, leather armor, etc.
~Forgeborn~.Notes: Smelting, forging, and crafting - must-know skills for many dwarves. It is not just a mere rumor that many of the best blacksmiths are dwarves, or have been born and raised in Forgeborn dwarf societies.
~Forgeborn~.Name: ~Forgeborn~

~Uldran Ancestry~.Effect:
You can spend 12 hours sleeping to recover 1d8 Health or get -50% Cold Damage taken until the end of next Combat.

Also, you can choose to hibernate for 48 hours to cure all your minor diseases and poisons.
~Uldran Ancestry~.Upgrade: Loud noises and movement still wake you up as they normally would.
~Uldran Ancestry~.Notes: The nordic dwarves have made hibernation a core skill to surviving the harsh winters of the mountains.
~Uldran Ancestry~.Name: ~Uldran Ancestry~

~Shoreraider~.Effect: When defeating people, your team loots +10% {Gold}Gold and goods like gems, metals, textiles, etc.
~Shoreraider~.Notes: Long boats, wooden homes and raiding parties are the common sight you grew up with, and you have learned much about these crafts throughout the years, for better or worse...
~Shoreraider~.Name: ~Shoreraider~

~Stonekin~.Effect: Use when you or an ally takes Damage that would make them fallen. That Damage is reduced by 100%.
~Stonekin~.Notes: Certain subspecies of dwarves come from Stonekin clans, and are fit for roles of leadership due to their thick, almost stone-like textured skin and temper.
~Stonekin~.Name: ~Stonekin~

~Rúndottir~.Effect: Inscribe one of the Runes below onto a weapon as an _extra Rune_, without actually needing to have that Rune.
~Rúndottir~.Upgrade: The weapon will also have its regular Rune slot, aside from this _extra Rune_.
~Rúndottir~.Notes: Some dwarven communities rely on runes for protection, enchantment and utility. Many of their buildings are laid out on key coordinates representing numbers or conceprs with strong meanings, and their clothes are often woven in the shape of constelations for good fortune and increased control over magic.

SpellTable.Name: Elemental Rune
SpellTable.Effect: Choose Fire, Cold or Shock. The attacker can freely change the Damage Type of the weapon to that element.

SpellTable.Name: Spirit Rune
SpellTable.Effect: Change any one Stat written on it to ^Focus^, ^Presence^, or ^Presence^.

SpellTable.Name: Lodestone
SpellTable.Effect: +2 Damage if the weapon scales with no Stat

SpellTable.Name: Wind Rune
SpellTable.Effect: Remove all Stat requirements for the weapon.

~Rúndottir~.Name: ~Rúndottir~

~Irontouched~.Effect: You have -1 Instinct, but +5 Max Health.
~Irontouched~.Notes:
Your skin has a metal-like sheen to it, your beard and hair are thick like metal strings and your finger nails resemble gems the same color as your eyes. As you age, these become more and more valuable, even being made of gold and emeralds in your days of age.
Dwarves with Irontouched ancestries have learend to be wary of strangers and bandits, many of whom will not waste the chance to kill and sell Irontouched body parts for money.
~Irontouched~.Name: ~Irontouched~

~Landliving~.Effect: You know have a Level 1 Druid Talent. You can change it inbetween Adventures.
~Landliving~.Notes: From more obscure and hidden dwellings around the world, the Landliving dwarves inhabit forests, hill-houses and sometimes swamps, and have learned to live off the land. However, some of them are said to innately wield nature magic, and they may be regarded as oddly special or particularly uncanny.
~Landliving~.Name: ~Landliving~

Extras: Meditate 4 hours per night instead of sleeping
~Meditation~.Effect:
As an Elf, your sleep is more akin to meditation and you only need 4 hours of sleep per night.
Elves don't dream and can still hear and smell while sleeping, but at a lower responsiveness.
~Meditation~.Name: ~Meditation~

~Gene Diversity~.Effect: When creating your Hero, choose 3 Elf Talents from below.
~Gene Diversity~.Name: ~Gene Diversity~

~High Elf Ancestry~.Effect: You know have a Level 1 Wizard Talent. You can change it inbetween Adventures.
~High Elf Ancestry~.Notes: You can pick Attention to get any Font Spell.
~High Elf Ancestry~.Name: ~High Elf Ancestry~

~Moon Elf Ancestry~.Effect:
Silence a non-Epic Unit.
Learn which of its Stats are higher than yours.
~Moon Elf Ancestry~.Name: ~Moon Elf Ancestry~
~Moon Elf Ancestry~.Notes: A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.

~Purebreed~.Effect: Destroy a Magic Item equipment piece to permanently gain its Magic Item properties.
~Purebreed~.Notes: E.g. you disenchant Gloves of Athletics to permanently gain Skilled in Athletics, or you disenchant Gloves of Fire Ball to permanently gain the power to cast Fire Ball with a 1 {A}Action Point once per Adventure.
~Purebreed~.Name: ~Purebreed~

Combat Extras: You can use bows and arrows with Stat Limit
~Wood Elf Ancestry~.Effect:
You have -1 Might, but +1 Movement Speed.
When using a Sword or Bow of any kind (except Sickle), you attack with your Stat Limit instead of that specific Stat.
~Wood Elf Ancestry~.Name: ~Wood Elf Ancestry~

~Dark Elf Ancestry~.Effect:
You know have a Level 1 Warlock Talent (except Evocations). You can change it inbetween Adventures.
You can generate {Evoke} Evoke Points like a Warlock.
~Dark Elf Ancestry~.Name: ~Dark Elf Ancestry~

~Aos Si Power~.Effect: Gain 1 {Mana}Mana. You must spend it this Turn.
~Aos Si Power~.Upgrade: With fox ears, the tail of a squirrel or eyes of a cat, the Aos Si (pronounced Ees Shee) are a mythical type of elf with whimsical roots in the strange magic of the forest. The animal traits are said to resemble the personality of the Aos Si from birth, the animal features do not necessarily correspond to the parents'!
~Aos Si Power~.Name: ~Aos Si Power~

~Faey Heritage~.Effect:
You know a Level 1 Druid Utility or Class Talent.
You can change it inbetween Adventures.
~Faey Heritage~.Name: ~Faey Heritage~

~Thimble Kin~.Effect: You have -1 Might, but +1 Instinct (up to the Level Limit). You can move through spaces of enemy Units. You can climb and ride on the back of an ally and move with them on their Turn (without them having a Speed penalty). You are Small.
~Thimble Kin~.Name: ~Thimble Kin~

Combat Extras: You don't age from time, but age when depressed, anxious, angry, etc. You see more colors and your dreams are vivid.
You don't have a sense of taste.
~Inherited Tastes~.Effect:
As a Littlefolk, you don't age from the passing of time. {Color('#470018' "Instead, you age more rapidly when you are suffering emotionally")} (in periods when you're depressed, anxious, fearful, etc).

You don't have a {Color('#003e1f' "sense of taste, but your eyes perceive a broader spectrum of colors")} than other races, including ultraviolet and infrared.

Littlefolk' daydreams tend to be {Color('#2d3e00' "very vivid, almost as vivid as regular dreams at night")} or akin to hallucinations.
~Inherited Tastes~.Name: ~Inherited Tastes~

~Life of Wonder~.Effect:
You start with 2 different {Link('Positive Quirks' '/Other/Quirks')} of choice, and 2 chosen Phobias of Monsters of choice (e.g. Zoophobia, Anxiety Around Cadavers, etc).
The chosen Phobias must be according to your Hero's personality traits.
~Life of Wonder~.Name: ~Life of Wonder~

~Halffolk Luck~.Effect: After another Unit you can see of you makes a roll, you can force them to reroll one die once and keep the new result.
~Halffolk Luck~.Notes: You are small in stature but big in heart, with nimble fingers, warm cheeks, and an easy smile that draws friends and fortune alike. You take life lightly, but your courage and cleverness often shine brightest when others least expect it.
~Halffolk Luck~.Name: ~Halffolk Luck~

~Redcap~.Effect:
After you defeat a Boss, transform a Negative Quirk into a similar Flaw, or a Skill into a similar Positive Quirk.
Passively, you age normally instead of aging from negative emotions, living 100 to 150 years.
~Redcap~.Upgrade: The Quest Master determines what a Boss is.
~Redcap~.Notes: Your kind is named for the blood-red caps you all wear not out of tradition, but because no one remembers you for anything else. Redcaps are the grumpy middle children of the smallfolk world: too mean to be gnomes, too lazy to be goblins, and too proud to admit either.
~Redcap~.Name: ~Redcap~

~Pixie Dust~.Effect: Your first single-target attack at most 3 meters away each Adventure makes the target Blind.
~Pixie Dust~.Notes:
With glittering, pink-hued skin and a sneeze that sends a puff of shimmering dust into the air, you're living proof that the Fey still whispers into the mortal world. Some say you were born from starlight that fell into enchanted groves, others that you're the laughter of ancient fey spirits made flesh. Your dreams are even stranger, colors even more vivid and personality stronger.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.
~Pixie Dust~.Name: ~Pixie Dust~

~Garden Home~.Effect: You know have a Level 1 Druid Talent. You can change it inbetween Adventures.
~Garden Home~.Notes: With rosy cheeks, a round nose, and an ever-dusty hat, you're a living charm of hearth and soil. Your kind was born from the earth's fondness for caretakers: guardians of roots, flowers, and forgotten corners of civilization. Your kind prefers living in ornate burrows with round doors, along cobblestone roads paved between mushrooms.
~Garden Home~.Name: ~Garden Home~

~Blueskin~.Effect: You start with an additional Positive Quirk of your choice, that you don't have already.
~Blueskin~.Notes: Born of ancient woodland magic, you stand no taller than a toadstool and wear the cheerful blues of your kin. Your kind thrives in harmony and craft, on teamwork and cooperation. There is loot awaiting in our adventures, but the true treasure is the friends we made along the way!
~Blueskin~.Name: ~Blueskin~

~Farsoulen Spirits~.Effect:
You and another Littlefolk party member were born as twins, and are said to be sprung off the same soul.
If both of you have this Talent, you both have the highest of both's baseline Health and Health Regen (without buffs and items).
Both of you start with an extra Hatred Positive Quirk and Phobia Negative Quirk (the same ones).
~Farsoulen Spirits~.Upgrade: The two of you are bound to eachother, and always know the direction of the other if separated. You feel eachother's joy and sorrow, no matter the distance.
~Farsoulen Spirits~.Name: ~Farsoulen Spirits~

~Kobold Reflex~.Effect:
The first time you would take Damage from a physical source each Adventure, you dodge the Damage and negate it (if it's dodge-able).
You get +1 Presence (up to your Level's Stat limit) and -1 Known Talent.
~Kobold Reflex~.Upgrade: You may dodge any Damage from a physical source that would make sense. You dodge the Damage, but if the attack had any other effects like Control Effects, it is still applied.
~Kobold Reflex~.Notes:
You have traits from the wild Kobolds, a race of feral Bertle-like folks with animal features, albeit much more agressive and less intelligent.
Choose which animal's visual features you would like to have!
~Kobold Reflex~.Name: ~Kobold Reflex~

Combat Extras: Your cauldron gains 10% of Gold from exploring and rewards
~Leprechauni~.Effect: As an olden secret technique of your kin, you have a special _cauldron_. Whenever your party finds or gains {Gold}Gold from exploring, lootting monsters or quest rewards, your _cauldron_ generates extra {Gold}Gold equal to 10% of the found amount.
~Leprechauni~.Upgrade: The Cauldron must be planted in a safe space, and can only be moved once per real month.
~Leprechauni~.Notes: Said to descend from fey tricksters who once bartered luck for gold, your skin carries a faint golden sheen, and your eyes glint like minted coins. Your tribes are drawn to the new and shiny, and your presence seems to coax gold from the air itself, as if fortune enjoys your company.
~Leprechauni~.Name: ~Leprechauni~

~Dom Voyager~.Effect:
The first time you deal Damage to an Enemy each Adventure, it becomes Rooted (Lagged if Epic).
You also have the Camping Ability.
~Dom Voyager~.Notes:
Dom Voyagers are gnomes with a touch of old household spirit in their blood. Sturdier and a little hairier than their kin, they have a homey presence and a knack for keeping spaces warm and welcoming.
A Lagged Unit's next Movement costs +1 Action Point.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.

~Camping~.Effect:
Setup camp, creating favorable conditions for your party for up to 8 in-game hours.
Units in the camp are protected from all bad weather and are immune to being poisoned by food.
Until the end of the Adventure, all Units who camped here are immune to Hard Terrain.

~Dom Voyager~.Name: ~Dom Voyager~

Combat Extras: You can see 5 meters in the dark
~Goblin Tendencies~.Effect:
The first time you attack with a weapon each Adventure, deal +1d6 Damage.
You have no penalty for attacking in the dark.
~Goblin Tendencies~.Notes: Your skin carries a greenish hue that seems to reflect your restless nature. . Your teeth are sharp and uneven, made for biting into life as much as food. It's hard for you to sit still, ideas come in bursts, and random naps are key to a healthy way of living.
~Goblin Tendencies~.Name: ~Goblin Tendencies~

~Family of Gremlins~.Effect: You have +1 Focus and +0.5 Initiative, but -1 Presence.
~Family of Gremlins~.Notes: Your skin carries a rough, teal-tinted hue. You're endlessly curious. Adrenaline is your constant companion, and boredom your greatest enemy.
~Family of Gremlins~.Name: ~Family of Gremlins~

~Of The Jee Tribes~.Effect:
The first time you use a Healing Spell each Adventure, it does +1d6 Healing.
You are mute and can not speak.
~Of The Jee Tribes~.Notes: Born from the whispers of ancient mountains and the songs of forgotten winds where your ancestors worship strange gods, you bear the legacy of your Jee tribe through your round body and pale shiny skin. You sense the world in subtler ways: vibrations in the air, the warmth of life, the harmony of life... if only you had a way to tell your story.
~Of The Jee Tribes~.Name: ~Of The Jee Tribes~

~Backwards Feet~.Effect: Backtrack to the last place you were before moving this Turn.
~Backwards Feet~.Notes: Your legs bear the mark of a strange mutation that occured among your folk long ago: slightly taller than other Littlefolk and your legs bent backwards. You live by cunning and instinct, protector and trickster both.
~Backwards Feet~.Name: ~Backwards Feet~

~Jack of all Trades~.Effect: You gain +1 in your lowest Stat and +2 Skills.
~Jack of all Trades~.Name: ~Jack of all Trades~

Combat Extras: You swim at normal Movement Speed
~Tideborn~.Effect: You can swim at your normal Movement Speed.
~Tideborn~.Name: ~Tideborn~

Combat Extras: You have an extra Level 1 Talent
~Blue Blood~.Effect: You can pick _one extra_ Level 1 Utility or Class Talent.
~Blue Blood~.Name: ~Blue Blood~

~Hunter-Gatherer~.Effect: Whenever you and your party defeat a boss, each Hero in the party learns a new random Skill.
~Hunter-Gatherer~.Notes: Everyone may learn different or the the same Skill. The Quest Master determines the Skills.
~Hunter-Gatherer~.Name: ~Hunter-Gatherer~

~Pigmy~.Effect:
Distract an enemy so that it won't attack you with its next attack.
At the end of this Combat, you gain +10% of all the {Gold}Gold and {Gold}Gold-worth of the valuables your party looted from this encounter (rounded down).
~Pigmy~.Name: ~Pigmy~

~Spiritually Aligned~.Effect: You are immune to being Silenced, Deafened and Cursed.
~Spiritually Aligned~.Name: ~Spiritually Aligned~
~Spiritually Aligned~.Notes:
A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.

~Fated~.Effect: At the start of each Combat, a random Enemy gets a ~Combo~.
~Fated~.Name: ~Fated~

~Genes of Olden Roots~.Effect: You gain +0.5 Initiative and you are immune to Exhaustion from lack of sleep.
~Genes of Olden Roots~.Name: ~Genes of Olden Roots~
~Genes of Olden Roots~.Notes: An Exhausted* Unit has -1 Action Point for each tier of Exhaustion. At Triple-Exhausted, the Unit dies.

~Diversity and Inclusion~.Effect: You get -1 Max Health. Choose a Race Talent from any other Race.
~Diversity and Inclusion~.Name: ~Diversity and Inclusion~

Combat Extras: When rolling equals, something weird might happen
~Augmented~.Effect:
You have +2 Max Health and +1 Health Regen, but -1 Presence.
When rolling equals on a Check, something slightly good or bad might happen to your body. The higher the roll, the better.
~Augmented~.Name: ~Augmented~

Combat Extras: Before a Check, you can take the average with -1.
~Human Vigilence~.Effect: Whenever you make a Roll of any kind, instead of rolling, you can automatically set the result to the average of the dice -1.
~Human Vigilence~.Name: ~Human Vigilence~

Combat Extras: Switch any Stat on Abilities/weapons to Presence
~Ignorance Bliss~.Effect: In weapons or Abilities, you can switch any of Focus or Presence written on it to ^Presence^.
~Ignorance Bliss~.Name: ~Ignorance Bliss~

~Alignment~.Effect:
Determine the true personality alignment of your Hero. Choose if you are Evil, Neutral or Virtuous. Your other Abilities must reflect your alignment.
You can't consume cooked food. If you are Virtuous, you can eat only raw vegetables and plants; if you are Evil, you can eat only raw meat; if you are Neutral, you can eat either.
~Alignment~.Notes: The QM decides if your alignment has changed based on your actions and character development. If your alignment changes throughout the adventure, your traits will automatically change to reflect your alignment.
~Alignment~.Name: ~Alignment~

~Davel Stare~.Effect: A target becomes Fumbling if you are Virtuous, Blinded if you are Neutral or Feared if you are Evil.
~Davel Stare~.Name: ~Davel Stare~
~Davel Stare~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Davel Gift~.Effect:
If you are Virtuous, Heal another target for 1d10 Health.
If you are Evil, Damage another target for 1d10 Psychic Damage.
If you are Neutral, another ally gains 1 {Mana}Mana and 5 Shielding, which last up to 1 minute.
~Davel Gift~.Notes: You can't cast this on yourself.
~Davel Gift~.Name: ~Davel Gift~

Combat Extras: -50% Damage Taken from your chosen element.
~Dragon Ancestry~.Effect:
When creating your Hero, choose any element from Acid, Cold, Fire, Shock, Pulse, Poison and Scourge.
You take -50% Damage from that Damage type.
~Dragon Ancestry~.Notes: The color of your skin and scales as a Dragon should reflect the element you chose (e.g. Cold might be associated with white or blue Dragonswarne).
~Dragon Ancestry~.Name: ~Dragon Ancestry~

~Burden of Passing~.Effect:
Your starting Stats are -2, -1, 0, 1.
Your are always 1 Level higher than what you're supposed to be.
~Burden of Passing~.Upgrade: With your extra Level, you do gain Level Up bonuses for it, as normal.
~Burden of Passing~.Notes: e.g. if playing with Experience, even if you have gained enough Experience to be Level 3, you are Level 4, but still require Experience for Level 3 to 4 to Level up - and so on. If playing with milestone Levels, you are simply always always 1 Level higher than what you're supposed to be. Maximum Level is 10.
~Burden of Passing~.Name: ~Burden of Passing~

~Burning By Silver~.Effect:
You are a cursed individual. Your race can be any of the available ones for cosmetic purposes, but your curse makes your race's abilities inert, and only have what the Hollow race provides.
You take +50% Damage when hit by silver weapons.
~Burning By Silver~.Name: ~Burning By Silver~

~Apex of Evolution~.Effect: Your starting Stats distribution is -2, 0, 2, 2 (instead of -1, 0, 1, 2).
~Apex of Evolution~.Name: ~Apex of Evolution~

Extras: Can create or dismantle items for Gold
~Artificer~.Effect:
Spending {Gold}Gold for its components, design and assemble a mechanized apparatus capable of performing simple, repetitive operations such as illumination, sound emission, olfactory diffusion, or the projection of pigment to form crude symbols or imagery.
You can create any normal weapon, armor, non-food general good or adventuring gear item piece by spending its {Gold}Gold cost.
You can _dismantle_ any good into {Gold}Gold equal to its selling worth.
~Artificer~.Notes: You can't use them to deal Damage, inflict Control Effects, or Heal. Typically, items sell at 25% of their base cost, and magic items at 50% of their base cost. Feel free to be creative with what you can do - the tools might do other small artificer tasks as well. Ask your QM! The spent {Gold}Gold for this is used as resource for obtaining or transmuting materials.
~Artificer~.Name: ~Artificer~

Popup.Message: After you get this Talent, manually add +1 to a Stat of choice. Go to My Character and click on the number you want to add or subtract from.

~Better Faster Stronger~.Effect:
You start with +1 in a Stat of choice (up to +2).

You may pick an extra number of Artificer Talents equal to your Focus.
~Better Faster Stronger~.Upgrade:
_Optimization through augmentation:_ the governing axiom of all Artificers. Every enhancement demands equivalence; every ascension a sacrifice. How much of your humanity will you surrender in pursuit of God?
Many Artificer Talents are conversions of your Presence into long-term, structural refinements, some of which can be gained over and over.
~Better Faster Stronger~.Notes: Some Artificer Talents may use your ^absolute^ Presence. Your absolute Presence is simply equal to your Presence without the ^minus^ sign, if any. E.g. the absolute of -3 Presence is 3. The absolute of 3 Presence is also 3.
~Better Faster Stronger~.Name: ~Better Faster Stronger~

~Actions With Valor~.Effect: Your Abilities and attacks in Worthy Combat may trigger extra effects if made immediately {Teal('After')} an Act that did a certain type of _thing_.
~Actions With Valor~.Upgrade:
The previous Act can be from your previous Turn, but from before Combat.
_Protection_ means giving Shielding, absorbing Damage, etc.
Slamming or Pushing count as _Control Effects_.
~Actions With Valor~.Notes: You can take a look at the ^tags^ of an Ability to see what kind of effects it can do. The {Teal('After')} effect can only trigger if the previous Act actually did that type of ^thing^. For example, "{Teal('After')} Mass Damage" can only trigger if the previous Act did Damage to more than 1 Unit. Apply common sense, and the Quest Master has the final say for whether an {Teal('After')} can trigger.
~Actions With Valor~.Name: ~Actions With Valor~

~Challenge of Arms~.Effect:
Roll 1d8.
Gain that as a Shielding, or Heal yourself for 50% of that.
Deal that as Smash Damage to a Unit, 50% of that to Units within 3 meters of you.
Slam yourself for that, or another Unit in any diretion for 50% of that.
~Challenge of Arms~.Notes: Use this to start a chain of Abilities With Valor! When you repeat this, choose the effects again and roll dice as normal. Obviously, the repeat does not retrigger another repeat.
~Challenge of Arms~.Name: ~Challenge of Arms~

~Chivalric Privilege~.Effect: Pick 2 Talents from the Level 1 Core Knight set.
~Chivalric Privilege~.Name: ~Chivalric Privilege~

~Unstable Spark~.Effect:
At the start of your every Turn in a Worthy Combat, roll 1d10. Apply any effects you have.
Other Talents will add extra effects to your Unstable Spark die.

{Spark(1)} you take 1d6 True Damage.
{Spark(10)} your next Spell this Turn has +50% Damage.
~Unstable Spark~.Upgrade: The Color('orange' 'orange d10') icon on a Sorcerer Ability means that effect triggers when you roll that number on the Unstable Spark die.
~Unstable Spark~.Notes: The triggered {Spark(numbers)} may or may not overlap.
~Unstable Spark~.Name: ~Unstable Spark~

~Overcharge~.Effect: Permanently learn one Level 1 Sorcerer Talent.
~Overcharge~.Notes: You may use this as many times as you want, until you learn all Level 1 Sorcerer Talents (works for both Utility or Class Talents). The {Mana}Mana spent is restored inbetween Adventures as usual. You can't replace the permanently learned Spell inbetween Adventures... and why would you, anyway?
~Overcharge~.Name: ~Overcharge~

~Blood in the Water~.Effect:
If your last 2 Acts that did Damage both either triggered a {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} or a ~Combo~, your next targeted {Type} {A}Action Point Act deals +{Amount}% Damage.

{Variants}
~Blood in the Water~.Notes: Note that misses do not break your chains of critting attacks, since only Acts that did Damage count towards this! For example, if you crit an attack, then miss, then crit another attack, then your next attack ^will^ benefit from Blood in the Water!
~Blood in the Water~.Name: ~Blood in the Water~
